mapper.select: SELECT p.id as id, p.name as name, p.description as description, p.product_image as productImage, p.sold as sold, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.price as price, p.view as view, pi.import_price as importPrice, pi.quantity as quantity, b.id as b_id, b.name as b_name, b.description as b_description, c.id as c_id, c.name as c_name, c.description as c_description FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_inventory pi ON pi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON pc.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = pc.category_id WHERE p.id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(name, description, price, product_image, brand_id, is_deleted) VALUES (#{productInfo.name}, #{productInfo.description}, #{productInfo.price}, #{productInfo.productImage}, #{productInfo.brandId}, #{productInfo.isDeleted})
INSERT INTO product_inventory(import_price, quantity, product_id) VALUES (#{importPrice}, #{quantity}, #{productId})
